events.verdict: Bogdanovic (LAC) briefly places both hands on Garland (CLE) on the perimeter, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.

Replay review of the foul called on Powell (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Powell reaches in and makes illegal contact to Allen's (CLE) wrist, causing him to lose control of the ball. Allen is not in a shooting motion at the time of the illegal contact and therefore, play resumes with a Cleveland throw-in.
Zubac (LAC) legally contests Allen's (CLE) shot attempt near the rim.
Harden (LAC) places his hands against Strus (CLE) with slight extension as he releases away, but the contact is marginal.
Mitchell (CLE) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Powell (LAC).
Jones Jr. (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Mitchell's (CLE) possession.
Strus (CLE) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Powell (LAC) reaches in and brushes Garland's (CLE) body and the contact is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Garland (CLE) during the drive, which affects his SQBR.
Hunter (CLE) lowers his arms, initiating illegal contact with Harden (LAC) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Batum (LAC) steps into Garland's (CLE) path and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR during the drive.
